## Checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed page has a `title` and a `description` (50–160 characters)
- [ ] Images have alt text that describes the screenshot
- [ ] Internal links start with `/docs/` and end with `/`
- [ ] It documents features that are already released
- [ ] I previewed the change (locally with `npm run dev`, or by reading the rendered Markdown)

A maintainer will review this pull request. The **Check docs** build must pass before it can be merged.
